war_summary: War 139 is on day 86 with no winner and conquest running; victory requires 32 towns. The front is split: Colonial holds full or near-full control in many regions (Acrithia, Allods Bight, Ash Fields, Drowned Vale, Farranac Coast, etc.), while Wardens hold others (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Howl County, Reaching Trail, Stlican Shelf, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse). Recent capture/flip activity is concentrated in Clahstra (21 events/24h, latest ~02:47), Mooring County (22 events/24h, latest ~00:46), Oarbreaker (22 events/24h, latest ~05:32), Stlican Shelf (26 events/24h, latest ~05:17), Endless Shore (8 events/24h), Morgens Crossing (4 events/24h), and Onyx (15 events/24h). Uncertainty remains high because several high-casualty regions (Callahans Passage, Dead Lands, Speaking Woods) show intense fighting but no recent event records, suggesting either stalled fronts or data lag; meanwhile accelerating enlistments in contested zones point to continued assaults over the next 24 hours.
